source.teamDataNote: The companion source CSV freezes TCDB's 440 numbered cards and 15 alternate printings with displayed team assignments. The generator reads only this local snapshot.

decisions.collectorChecklistIntegrity: One combined 440-card Base ProductSet spanning Series I #1-336 and Series II #337-440. All numbered cards have equal VCS availability and one shared completion percentage.
decisions.physicalShortPrints: TCDB marks some individual cards SP, including All-Stars and selected first-series cards. These are noted on those entries, but the combined VCS base pool deliberately gives every #1-440 card equal odds.
decisions.variations: Fourteen alternate b printings and the unnumbered #13 error are preserved as a separate 15-card Variations ProductSet. Each a printing supplies its numbered Base slot; #13's numbered correction supplies Base #13. Historical variation odds are unknown and therefore not invented.
decisions.trueRookieNaming: The 51 distinct card numbers flagged as true rookie cards in TCDB's rookie index receive an RC suffix. Tom Hammonds #298 has two printings but is one distinct base RC number; generic RS and Lottery Pick labels do not create other RC names.
decisions.relatedSets: The two wrapper mail-in offers and five promo sets shown in TCDB are not part of the standard pack-issued checklist and are excluded from this draft.
decisions.packConfiguration: One combined VCS four-card pack uses the Series I pack-image slot. A 36-pack box follows the Series I wax-box configuration. Images and pricing remain pending.
decisions.releaseSafety: Keep unreleased until the Series I pack art, card images, pricing and any desired variation pack treatment are reviewed.

productSets.name: Base
productSets.notes: Unified #1-440. Series I #1-336; Series II #337-440. All numbered base cards equally available in the four-card VCS pack despite physical series and short-print differences.

productSets.name: Errors and Variations
productSets.notes: Fourteen b alternates plus the unnumbered #13 error. This separate checklist leaves the main Base completion at 440. Unknown physical variation odds remain unset.
